title: SUSS: What a Transformer Learns When It Adapts to Unknown Physics In-Context (code, pre-registration, results, paper)
description:
Code, pre-registration, results and paper for a pre-registered mechanistic study of small transformers trained from scratch to adapt in-context to unknown dynamics (linear systems with unknown parameters, MuJoCo systems with contact, linear adaptive control).

The pre-registration (hypotheses, metrics, seeds and statistical tests) is the git commit tagged prereg-d134c5a (2026-11-05), made before the main experiments; this archive is a later snapshot of the repository and does not by itself time-stamp the pre-registration. All deviations are listed in docs/DEVIATIONS.md.
